notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing from the Mozio email confirmation for return trip tickets. The discount data flows through mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (which does pass discount through when present), so the root cause is likely upstream — either apply-report-discounts.service.ts skips the return-trip dispatch, or map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts strips the discount during return-trip line item modification. ACs were empty; derived from description per reviewer mandate.
